authorization: User requested redesign: training then freeze, predict reserved samples, few-shot calibration and paired accuracy comparison; export three dedicated file roles.
scope: retrospective within-batch anonymous-origin holdout and score adaptation
prior_exposure: All 855 records were previously used in internal CV. This split is retrospective and cannot create a first-use confirmatory test set.
source_workbooks: data/active_workbooks.json: current seven numbered zaoren workbooks only
split_algorithm: Sort classes and physical IDs lexically; numpy Generator(PCG64(split_seed)); sequential class-wise permutation; first 60% training, next 20% calibration, remainder prediction; stable sorted IDs on export.

roles.training: Source-only model tuning and full source fit; transforms/feature selector and classifier frozen after fit.
roles.calibration: Exclusive labelled support pool; labels may train the attached score adjustment; unused support never enters prediction.
roles.prediction: Exactly the same 171 samples before and after calibration; labels only for scoring, never fit, tune or select.

export.id_warning: ZY prefix and grouping of exported files disclose anonymous origin; models use numerical spectra only.

frequency.scope: fixed engineering candidate range, not instrument-validated optimal interval

training.score_rule: argmax of aligned class scores; exact ties resolve to first source class
training.feature_selection_scope: inside each source training CV fold, then source full refit

calibration.regularization_selection: fixed before this experiment's predictions, not optimized on reserved prediction labels
calibration.unavailable_reason: ZY02 calibration pool contains one independent sample
calibration.scope: score adjustment, not probability calibration or cross-batch adaptation

evaluation.paired_gains: Same fixed query, report percentage-point changes and corrected/harmed sample counts
evaluation.uncertainty: Support-draw variation on one fixed query; not independent trials, batches, or confidence intervals
evaluation.minority_limitation: One ZY02 prediction specimen; recall is only 0 or 100 percent
evaluation.selection_policy: No accuracy-based choice of seed, split, model, repeat, lambda or frequency range; no guaranteed improvement

excluded: counting repeated draws as independent experiments
SMOTE used to claim additional independent samples
outputs_required: role label files plus separate prediction truth
numerical identity and source hash verification
model source CV configuration and support draws
